CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SACHIN SHANKAR MAGADUM  ORAL ORDER (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SACHIN SHANKAR MAGADUM)
Learned counsel for the petitioner has filed a memo seeking leave of this Court to withdraw the petition with liberty to file petition afresh.
The memo is taken on record and the Criminal Petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty, as prayed for.
